name: search_wdp_person
description: Cheap discovery of a person in the War Data Platform (WDP) by ORCID or name. Returns person SUMMARIES only — identity, affiliations known to WDP, publication and funding-record COUNTS, and a ref_id. It never returns the publications or funding records themselves: to get actual document detail, chain retrieve_wdp_documents with the returned ref_id. Prefer orcid when available — it is an exact identifier match, and RFFF tools return person_orcid as the bridge identifier; fall back to a name search when no ORCID is known (also the suggested repair after a not_found on an orcid lookup). A person may legitimately have no WDP records: empty results are a reportable gap, not an error. Provide at least one of orcid or name.

orcid.description: Exact ORCID match — the bridge identifier returned by RFFF tools as person_orcid. Never fabricate one.

name.description: Person name, partial/fuzzy match. Use when no ORCID is known.

limit.description: Maximum summaries to return; the server additionally caps every response at MCP_MAX_ROWS.

ref_id.description: Opaque WDP reference; pass to retrieve_wdp_documents for document detail.

affiliations.description: Affiliations known to WDP (may differ from RFFF affiliations).
